paper_core_claims.claim: A domain knowledge tree can guide targeted mining of repositories, APIs, scripts, notebooks, documentation, databases and papers, while its linked resources, skills and validation states evolve with coverage.
Mined resources can be compiled into self-contained skill packages with scope, inputs/outputs, steps, dependencies, environment assumptions, provenance, examples, scripts, assets and tests.
Execution, system, synthetic-data and downstream utility testing can drive repair, acceptance, merging and pruning in a closed loop.

The author-reported writing-time snapshot contains 286 skills from 394 resources across 27 domains/254 subdomains, all retained skills pass required tests, and 71.1 percent are novel relative to SkillHub/SkillSMP.
Author-reported skill access improves five of six 88-task MoSciBench subsets and improves one spatial-transcriptomics annotation run and a three-replicate scDRS workflow.

function_concept_used_by_paper: A skill is a reusable package around a human-readable SKILL.md contract plus optional executable scripts, tests, assets and metadata. Its contract names task scope, dependencies, inputs/outputs, procedure, environment assumptions, provenance and examples. The public implementation realizes both runnable wrappers and many starter-plan artifacts; therefore the skill abstraction ranges from executable capability to procedural planning specification and cannot uniformly be read as an executed scientific function.
representation_or_carrier: The control carrier is a rooted domain tree whose nodes link resources, skills and validation state. Resource registries are JSONL records with topic paths, signals, scores, provenance and status. Skill registries link IDs/paths, domains/subdomains, resources, status and summaries; each filesystem package carries SKILL.md, metadata, scripts/assets/tests where available. Campaign state, worker workspaces, reports and generated dashboards are additional carriers, though campaign/experiment receipts are absent from the audited public head.
specification_language: SKILL.md is the primary natural-language contract: task purpose and scope, trigger/use conditions, required inputs, outputs, stepwise workflow, environment/dependency assumptions, examples, provenance and validation guidance. Registry/metadata JSON adds IDs, topic placement, sources and coarse status. These schemas do not machine-enforce types, pre/postconditions, declared effects, permissions, resource bounds, failure taxonomies, compatibility or scientific correctness; status implemented can denote a plan-producing starter rather than verified domain execution.
compiler_or_generator: The staged LLM pipeline maps tree gaps to resource_search, extracts source-grounded contracts through skill_build/design_skill, emits SKILL.md/scripts/assets/tests, evaluates with skill_test/layer1_fix/layer2_benchmark/layer2_optimize, checks novelty, and lets refresh update shared registries/tree/site. GPT-5.4 and GPT-5.4-mini roles are specified and concrete orchestration/prompt/repository code is public. However, published prompts are explicitly abbreviated, campaign receipts and the paper snapshot are absent, semantic preservation is not proved, and the public repository cannot reproduce the reported 286/394 build.
interpreter_or_runtime: Codex- or Claude-style agents discover and read SKILL.md, then follow prose and invoke bundled scripts in local, sandbox or Slurm contexts. Repository execution helpers isolate leaf workers, collect structured reports and restrict automatic merging to leaf-owned paths; refresh owns shared registries. The interpreter remains an LLM plus shell/Python runtime, so adherence to contracts, environment compatibility, external side effects, scientific interpretation and approval boundaries are not enforced by a formal runtime.
composition_rule: Taxonomy paths route resources and skills; leaf packages combine prose, scripts, assets and tests; refresh merges isolated leaf outputs into shared registries; novelty review discards duplicates, merges complementary scope or creates a new leaf. Composition is path/ownership- and prompt-governed rather than type/effect checked. The novelty code scores a small local candidate set with LLM/web-search assistance, not the paper's fully receipted binary comparison against named external libraries, and no merge-equivalence or regression invariant is published.
state_or_effect_model: Live state records tree coverage, linked resources/skills, validation status, campaign stages, workspace ownership and reports. Skills may execute filesystem, Python, network or cluster operations, but effect signatures, capabilities, secrets, irreversible actions, transaction boundaries, idempotence, compensation and rollback are not modeled. Isolated leaf workspaces reduce shared-file conflicts, while shared refresh is a governance convention rather than transactional composition.
uncertainty_model: The paper supplies point estimates only. MoSciBench contains 88 tasks with small per-dataset denominators of 13-17 and no repeated runs, paired confidence intervals or significance tests. The cell experiment is one clustered dataset with one reported run; cells are not independent replicates. scDRS has three replicates, but no intervals/test and one skill-assisted qualitative score is no better than the worst baseline. Novelty has no numerator, sampling frame, recall/precision, judge agreement or sensitivity; 71.1 percent cannot be a one-decimal rounded binary fraction of 286 or the public 267. LLM and web judgments are not calibrated uncertainty.

validation_regime.formal: tree and pipeline are described operationally; no theorem, formal semantics, mechanized proof, compiler-preservation result or lifecycle invariant is supplied
validation_regime.library_internal: paper describes execution, system/Slurm and synthetic-data tests plus repair/removal, then optional layer-2 with/without-skill utility and novelty review; appendix qualifies testing as possible/appropriate rather than establishing universal execution

validation_regime.public_full_test: the documented fresh-clone make test path yields 85 passes, 8 failures and 89 errors out of 182; absent external environments explain many errors but do not support an all-public-skills-validated reading
validation_regime.starter_semantics: 234 of 267 directories are starters; a representative implemented starter's smoke test validates generation of a starter plan, metadata and promotion checklist, not performance of the named scientific capability
validation_regime.snapshot_reconciliation: all 11 public commits contain exactly 267 skills and 375 resources, so the paper's 286/394 writing-time snapshot and all-retained-pass receipts cannot be checked from the linked repository
validation_regime.novelty: paper defines binary same-task novelty against SkillHub/SkillSMP via keywords, but releases no candidate list, queries, matches, decisions or numerator; repository contains no recorded per-skill novelty results and its current LLM score path is methodologically different
validation_regime.moscibench: 88 tasks across six datasets; skills improve author-reported success on five, with absolute changes of one or two tasks per improved subset and no repeated-run uncertainty
validation_regime.cell_annotation: one MERFISH developing-heart dataset with 228635 cells, 238 genes, three samples and eight harmonized types; author-reported Codex coverage rises from 68.5/81.1 to 82.9/99.2 percent versus SpatialAgent 87.1/100, without repeated runs or public traces
validation_regime.scdrs: three expert-blinded replicates; mean RMSE is reported as about 0.11 without versus 0.02 with skills, but expert count, rubric/adjudication, raw outputs and statistical uncertainty are absent
validation_regime.prompts_and_runtime: appendix promises implementation detail but explicitly publishes abbreviated prompts; instantiated prompts, run counts, exact hardware and task manifests for key evaluations remain unavailable
validation_regime.reproducibility: paper/source and a substantial Apache-2.0 implementation/library are public, yet the reported snapshot, task-specific skills, benchmark splits, exact environments, novelty receipts, raw outputs, traces and results are not

equivalence_notions.boundary: No released match set, behavioral test, scope entailment, version pin or false-positive/false-negative audit establishes duplicate equivalence.
No compatibility, conflict, provenance-preservation or regression rule is published for the merged artifact.
Single runs, small task sets, unreported instantiated prompts and unreleased skills/traces prevent a stable causal or behavioral-equivalence conclusion.
Public status labels and starter smoke tests are heterogeneous; validation may establish package structure or plan generation rather than scientific-task correctness.

lifecycle_and_provenance: The public system has skill/resource IDs, topic paths, source URLs, provenance fields, status labels, update timestamps/log prose, campaign stages, isolated worker ownership and shared refresh. Git supplies repository history. It lacks immutable content hashes and per-skill semantic versions, explicit parent/derivation lineage, dependency compatibility, reviewer/model/prompt receipts, per-status admission criteria, deprecation/tombstone semantics, release channels, rollback/restore records and a tag matching the paper snapshot. Update-log references to report directories are not tracked at the audited head, and all public commits disagree with the paper's library size.
limitations_and_failure_boundaries: The exact paper is an under-review arXiv v1 preprint; its CC BY source contains no executable implementation or result artifacts.
The linked public repository is substantial, but every one of its 11 commits has 267 skills and 375 resources rather than the paper's 286 and 394; no matching tag/release is public.
The paper's writing-time qualification does not reconcile the missing snapshot because neither immutable bytes nor a commit ID is given.
A binary count out of 286 cannot round to 71.1 percent at one decimal; the novelty numerator/denominator is internally unreconciled. The same is true for the public denominator 267.
No per-skill external search query, SkillHub/SkillSMP version, match list, merge/discard decision, assessor or novelty receipt is released.
The public implementation's five-candidate LLM/web novelty score is not the same receipted method as the paper's binary keyword-search description.
All retained skills passing required tests is not supported by the public statuses: 145 are only implemented, 118 sandbox_verified and four slurm_verified.
234 of 267 public skills are named starters; representative tests can validate plan/metadata generation without executing the named scientific capability.
Fresh-clone make validate proves registry/package structure, not scientific correctness or successful execution of all skills.
Fresh-clone make test completed with 85/182 passing, 8 failures and 89 errors; external runtime omissions explain many errors but still make the advertised public test surface non-green.
The linked repository tracks no experiments or reports at the audited head, including the paper's benchmark skills, task manifests, raw outputs, traces and result summaries.
Update-log claims of earlier full test passes and report bundles cannot be independently checked because the referenced receipts are absent from all audited head files.
MoSciBench improvements are one or two additional successes within 13-17-task subsets; no repeats, paired intervals or significance analysis are supplied.
The no-change NURSE subset bounds the claim to five of six datasets rather than uniform improvement.
The spatial-cell metrics use one dataset/run; 228635 cells are clustered observations, not independent experimental repetitions.
The scDRS experiment has only three replicates and no interval/test; one with-skill qualitative score of three matches the worst baseline score.
Expert count, blinding procedure beyond the stated label, scoring rubric reliability and inter-rater agreement are not reported.
The appendix says full prompts/run counts/hardware are deferred, then explicitly states that its templates are abbreviated; instantiated prompts and run counts remain absent.
The fixed resource-mining search budget is unnamed and runtime excludes API-token use, so scaling/cost cannot be reproduced.
Internal execution of a wrapper or synthetic example does not establish downstream scientific validity; the authors themselves separate internal from utility evaluation.
Natural-language contracts and LLM generation do not establish type/effect safety, semantic preservation, scientific correctness or safe external composition.
Parallel leaf ownership reduces write conflicts but supplies no transaction, rollback, permission or external-effect semantics.
Self-evolving is demonstrated as architecture and update-log history, not as a released autonomous longitudinal campaign with before/after state and complete receipts.
Registry status/provenance are useful but not a versioned, immutable, rollback-capable lifecycle.
The system does not provide probabilistic program semantics, calibrated decision uncertainty, formal program equivalence or weight-space composition.
what_the_paper_does_not_support: It does not support the exact 286-skill/394-resource public snapshot or an independently checkable all-retained-pass claim.
It does not support 71.1 percent as a reconciled binary novelty fraction of the stated library.
It does not support interpreting every public starter smoke test as execution of the named scientific capability.
It does not establish statistical significance, robust reproducibility or causal downstream improvement from the small single-run evaluations.
It does not establish semantic equivalence, safe merge preservation or scientifically correct generated skills.
It does not establish a production-safe, transactional, versioned or rollback-capable self-evolving registry.
It does not empirically validate ignition, stochastic ignition semantics or neural weight-space composition.

GAP-015.reason: SKILL.md plus registry/metadata define a concrete external natural-language FunctionSpec with scope, inputs/outputs, steps, environment assumptions, provenance, examples and tests.

GAP-016.reason: A public staged implementation transforms tree gaps and heterogeneous resources into concrete skill packages under explicit worker/refresh ownership, although semantic correctness and the paper snapshot are not reproduced.

GAP-017.reason: Duplicate, complementary and same-task notions drive discard/merge/utility decisions, but no behavioral equivalence, compatibility or preservation evidence is released.

GAP-018.reason: Scripts, sandbox/Slurm execution, tests and reports expose operational effects, while typed effects, permissions, transactions and rollback are absent.

GAP-019.reason: IDs, topic paths, provenance, statuses, timestamps, update logs and Git provide lifecycle primitives, but immutable versions, derivation, admission receipts, deprecation and rollback are incomplete.

GAP-020.reason: The framework reports point estimates and heuristic novelty/validation judgments without probabilistic or stochastic function semantics.

N1_FunctionSpec.reason: SKILL.md contracts and metadata cover scope, invocation context, inputs/outputs, procedure, environment, provenance, examples and checks.

N2_Representation.reason: Domain trees, JSONL registries, filesystem packages, metadata, reports and dashboards are explicit public carriers.

N3_Compiler.reason: Public orchestration, prompts and repository code implement tree_check, search, build/design, test/fix/benchmark/optimize, novelty and refresh stages, bounded by abbreviated prompts and unreconciled outputs.

N4_Artifact.reason: The public repository contains 267 concrete SKILL.md packages with scripts, assets and tests where applicable; their depth and execution status are heterogeneous.

N5_Interpreter.reason: Codex/agent runtimes consume SKILL.md and invoke bundled scripts in local, sandbox or cluster contexts.

N6_ExecutionTrace.reason: The framework defines run/workspace/report carriers and some tests emit artifacts, but paper experiment and autonomous-campaign traces are not tracked at the public head.

N7_Validator.reason: Structural, execution, system, synthetic and downstream validators are implemented, but all-retained validation is unreconciled, public status semantics vary and fresh-clone full tests are non-green.

N8_ComposerRouter.reason: Tree coverage routes mining and refresh owns merge/discard/new-leaf updates, but semantic equivalence, compatibility and complete novelty decisions are heuristic and unreceipted.

N9_VersionedRegistry.reason: Public registries, status/provenance fields, timestamps, update logs and Git history exist, while the paper snapshot, content versions/hashes, derivation, tombstones and rollback are missing.

corrections: Verified the complete resource-to-contract-to-package pipeline and its public repository implementation.
Separated structural validation and starter-plan smoke tests from execution of the named scientific capability.
Audited all 11 public commits and found 267 skills/375 resources throughout, with no 286/394 paper snapshot or release.
Detected that 71.1 percent cannot be a rounded binary fraction of the stated 286 or public 267 denominator and recorded the missing numerator/receipts.
Ran the documented fresh-clone structural and full test surfaces and preserved their distinct pass/non-green outcomes.
Bounded MoSciBench, cell-annotation and scDRS results to small author-reported point estimates without independent reproduction or statistical uncertainty.
Distinguished useful registry/provenance fields from a complete versioned, immutable and rollback-capable lifecycle.

partial_projection: SkillFoundry provides unusually strong bounded evidence for an external FunctionSpec-Representation-Compiler-Artifact-Interpreter architecture and substantial public implementations of validation, routing and registry nodes. The overall projection is partial because the public history cannot supply the paper's 286/394 snapshot, the 71.1 percent novelty fraction is arithmetically and procedurally unreconciled, many public starters validate plans rather than domain capability, the fresh-clone full suite is non-green, and all key experiment/novelty/campaign receipts and lifecycle guarantees are absent.
source_specific_reasoning: PARTIAL is mandatory. The exact paper, source and linked codebase establish a real staged compiler, concrete package/registry carriers, isolated worker discipline and a large public skill library. They do not establish the scale and universal-validation claims used in the paper: all 11 public commits remain at 267/375 rather than 286/394; no binary numerator produces 71.1 percent of 286 at one decimal; 234 public packages are starters; and the documented full test surface passes only 85 of 182 tests in a fresh clone. The downstream results remain author-reported small point estimates with unreleased prompts, skills, tasks and traces. This review preserves the implementation contribution without calling model review proof or independent empirical validation.
projection_boundary: These are 121CX projections from the complete exact 19-page CC BY arXiv v1 PDF, all rendered pages, complete source archive, official metadata and the full public Apache-2.0 repository history through 4a8cc0c, including fresh-clone structural/full-test audits. This model review is not a mechanized proof, reproduction of the unreleased 286/394 snapshot, independent execution of paper experiments, scientific validation of starter capabilities, security certification, or empirical validation of ignition.
